entries.title: II Peter 3:1
segments: By putting you in remembrance. It is evident that even at this early period false teachings were so rife that Peter felt constrained to turn back the thought of the brethren to the purity of the original word.

entries.title: II Peter 3:17
segments: The error of the wicked. As the exhortation is to stedfastness it appears that the 'wicked' referred to are the false teachers mentioned in the beginning of chapter 2.

entries.title: II Peter 3:18
segments: For ever. The glory of Christ is to be eternal.
